name: Built-in fields
summary: Executable Go field definitions cover scalar, choice, structured, relationship, media, layout, computed, and plugin-owned values.

name: Relationships and joins
summary: Forward relationships, upload references, population, reference policies, and read-only inverse joins share the operation engine.

name: Content and admin localization
summary: Localized storage, fallbacks, all-locale reads, copy-locale authoring, RTL presentation, and translated admin chrome are implemented.
qualificationLimits: Application content translations and admin interface translations are configured independently.

name: Local Go API
summary: Typed local operations enter the same access, validation, hook, transaction, and redaction engine as remote transports.

name: REST API and generated SDK
summary: Generated TypeScript contracts and the Fetch-based SDK cover collection and global operations exposed by REST.
qualificationLimits: Select and populate inputs are typed, while response projections retain the full generated output type.

name: Embedded admin authoring
summary: The embedded Svelte admin provides collection and global routes, schema-driven forms, lists, saved views, drawers, bulk actions, and static extension points.

name: Editorial workflows
summary: Drafts, versions, publishing, scheduling, locks, trash, duplication, and atomic bulk actions are available through shared operation contracts.

name: Live preview
summary: Saved draft preview and optional unsaved postMessage updates work with short-lived, access-checked preview capabilities.
qualificationLimits: Preview grants are process-local; multi-replica deployments need session affinity for preview reads.

name: Uploads and object storage
summary: Multipart and guarded remote ingestion, image sizes, focal regeneration, private delivery, local storage, and S3-compatible storage are implemented.
qualificationLimits: Resumable and direct-to-storage upload, quarantine, and malware scanning are not included.

name: PostgreSQL adapter
summary: Use PostgreSQL when the database is a separate service or the application runs on multiple hosts.
qualificationLimits: When a release adds migrations, follow the documented drain, verify, snapshot, migrate, status, and start sequence.

name: SQLite adapter
summary: Pure-Go SQLite supports local-file applications and small or local workloads on one host.
qualificationLimits: Shared network filesystems and horizontally replicated deployments are not supported; backups must be SQLite-aware or taken after quiescing WAL writers.

name: MongoDB adapter
summary: Use MongoDB only with Ridu’s supported version, security, topology, and platform configuration.
qualificationLimits: Support covers generated starter and blank projects on Linux x86-64, MongoDB Community 8.2.9, SCRAM-SHA-256, verified TLS, and a writable three-member replica set.
Atlas, DocumentDB, Cosmos DB, standalone servers, other versions or topologies, and generic live cross-adapter data migration are not supported.

name: Rich text plugin
summary: The paired Go and Svelte Lexical integration provides schema-owned rich-text documents, validation, uploads, and admin authoring.

name: SEO plugin
summary: The paired SEO plugin adds typed metadata fields and static admin authoring without bypassing normal field contracts.

name: Form Builder plugin
summary: Form Builder provides compiled form definitions, validation, submissions, email and payment extension points, and a paired admin experience.

name: GraphQL plugin
summary: The opt-in GraphQL plugin adds generated queries and mutations for supported Ridu resources.
qualificationLimits: The API may change before the plugin is marked available; applications that do not import it do not include GraphQL.

name: MCP plugin
summary: The opt-in MCP transport exposes explicitly selected, access-checked collection and global reads to authenticated clients.
qualificationLimits: Write tools, prompts, custom resources, and source-code mutation are not supported.

name: Custom fields
summary: Compiled Go field semantics can be paired with statically registered Svelte components through public plugin contracts.

name: Durable tasks
summary: Typed handlers, retries, leases, heartbeats, cancellation, concurrency keys, and retention run through official stores.
qualificationLimits: Workflow checkpoints, declarative cron, email/import/export adapters, and an access-controlled task admin are not included.

name: Live server validation
summary: Show server validation messages before saving, including in custom and embedded field editors. Save rules run separately.
qualificationLimits: Only fields with LiveValidate callbacks are checked. Checks do not run defaults or save hooks; callbacks must avoid side effects and respect cancellation.
Checks use one exact content locale. The first-user setup form does not request live checks.
